hunks.baseline: The Head Elder felt the air tremble. In the same instant, he understood how much destructive power the spearhead shooting toward his chest carried.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder felt the air tremble. In the same instant, he grasped the destructive power behind the spearhead hurtling toward his chest.

hunks.baseline: A threat to his life he had felt only a handful of times. Every hair on his body stood on end, and the world slowed.
hunks.sol: It was a threat to his life unlike all but a handful he had ever faced. Every hair on his body stood on end, and the world slowed.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung’s spear came from the front, while Jin Wikyung’s sword flew in from behind. The two brothers’ pincer attack meshed with perfect timing.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung’s spear came from the front while Jin Wikyung’s sword flew in from behind. The two brothers’ pincer attack came together with exquisite timing.

hunks.baseline: The sixty years of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone. It poured vitality into his aging muscles and woke his blood vessels. The change did not stop there.
hunks.sol: The sixty years of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian surged through his entire body. It poured vitality into his aging muscles and awakened his meridians.
And the transformation did not end there.

hunks.baseline: The Sword Energy that had risen nearly a foot—thirty centimeters—compressed to half its size.
hunks.sol: The Sword Energy extending nearly a foot from his blade compressed to half its length.

hunks.baseline: That was not a loss of power. It was condensation.
hunks.sol: But this was no loss of power. It was a concentration of it.

hunks.baseline: The Sword Energy that had fluttered like a thread wrapped the entire blade and took the shape of another sword.
hunks.sol: The threadlike Sword Energy wrapped around the entire blade, taking the shape of another sword.

hunks.baseline: The symbol of the superhuman masters who had broken through the wall of the Peak realm and opened a great new domain.
hunks.sol: The symbol of superhuman masters who had broken through the wall of the Peak realm and forged into a greater domain.

hunks.baseline: It was still incomplete, only half-formed, but it was unmistakably Sword Force—the distilled essence of the martial arts the Head Elder had spent his life mastering.
hunks.sol: It was still incomplete, only half-formed, but it was unmistakably Sword Force—the culmination of the martial arts the Head Elder had spent his entire life mastering.

hunks.baseline: Even the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s ancestral treasure sword was cut apart, Sword Energy and all. Jin Wikyung’s internal energy scattered in an instant, and his insides were wrenched. His face went pale.
hunks.sol: Even the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s ancestral treasure sword was severed, Sword Energy and all. Jin Wikyung’s internal energy scattered in an instant, the shock wrenching his insides. His face went pale.

hunks.baseline: One stroke would have been enough to take his neck.
hunks.sol: A single stroke would have been enough to take his head.

hunks.baseline: He reached for the spear now almost at his chest. His wrinkled hand, too, was wrapped in a dazzling radiance of qi.
hunks.sol: He reached for the spear already closing on his chest. His wrinkled hand, too, was wreathed in a dazzling radiance of qi.

hunks.baseline: This, too, was an incomplete Hand Force, but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.
hunks.sol: This was also incomplete—an imperfect Hand Force—but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.
No.

hunks.baseline: No. It looked like enough.
hunks.sol: It only looked like enough.

hunks.baseline: Until the vortex spilling from the spearhead swallowed him whole.
hunks.sol: Then the vortex pouring from the spearhead swallowed him whole.

hunks.baseline: A deathly silence settled. It felt as if the dozens of people here—or perhaps everyone standing on the battlefield—were watching us.
hunks.sol: A deathly silence settled over the battlefield. It felt as though the dozens gathered here—perhaps everyone still standing—were watching us.

hunks.baseline: At the end of countless gazes, the Head Elder slowly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Countless gazes converged on the Head Elder as he slowly opened his mouth.

hunks.baseline: Even speaking the words brought on a vicious hunger. Every muscle in my body stung, and not a scrap of internal energy was left inside me.
hunks.sol: Even saying the words brought on a vicious hunger. Every muscle in my body stung, and not a scrap of internal energy remained inside me.

hunks.baseline: Unlike with Jopil, I didn’t pass out or crumple pathetically to the ground.
hunks.sol: Unlike when I’d fought Jopil, I didn’t pass out or crumple pathetically to the ground.

hunks.baseline: I had grown enough to take One Flash’s side effects. And as much as I had grown, One Flash’s power had grown with me.
hunks.sol: I had grown enough to withstand One Flash’s side effects. And as I had grown stronger, so had One Flash.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder’s current state was proof of that.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s current state was proof.

hunks.baseline: He muttered it under his breath and pressed an acupoint on his shoulder.
hunks.sol: Muttering under his breath, he pressed an acupoint on his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: The bleeding stopped, but that was all. The arm ground to nothing by the vortex One Flash had unleashed did not come back.
hunks.sol: The bleeding stopped, but that was all. The arm ground away without a trace by One Flash’s vortex did not return.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder gave a hollow laugh and turned toward Jin Wikyung.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder gave a hollow laugh and turned to Jin Wikyung.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve got a frightening younger brother.”
hunks.sol: “You have a frightening younger brother.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung asked, his face wan,

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Does that child frighten you?”
hunks.sol: His face wan, Jin Wikyung asked, “Does that child frighten you?”

hunks.baseline: Not a hint of hesitation. A smile bloomed over his pale face.
hunks.sol: Not a hint of hesitation.
A smile spread across his pale face.

hunks.baseline: “I raised him like gold and jade, but he grew into steel. That’s the kind of child Taekyung is.”
hunks.sol: “I raised him like gold and jade, and he grew into steel. That’s the kind of child Taekyung is.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder stared at that smile.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder stared at his smile.

hunks.baseline: “You’re a fairly impressive talent. Enough to shoulder the future of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.”
hunks.sol: “You’re a fairly impressive talent. Worthy of shouldering the future of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung reaching the Peak realm at twenty was one thing. Getting ranked that high myself was almost more than I could take, but…
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung reaching the Peak realm at twenty was one thing. Having him rate me so highly was almost more than I deserved, but…

hunks.baseline: As if he’d read my mind, the Head Elder went on.
hunks.sol: As if he had read my mind, the Head Elder continued.

hunks.baseline: “Power is what you don’t even share with your own blood. When that time comes, will you still be so proud of your younger brothers?”
hunks.sol: “Power is the one thing you don’t share, even with your own blood. When that time comes, will you still be so proud of your younger brothers?”

hunks.baseline: The air around us went ice-cold in an instant.
hunks.sol: The air around us went ice-cold.

hunks.baseline: Everyone facing the Head Elder at close range belonged to the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Cautious looks clung to my cheeks, then quietly slid away.
hunks.sol: Everyone facing the Head Elder at close range belonged to the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Wary glances touched my cheeks, then quietly slipped away.

hunks.baseline: *Family Head? I have no intention of doing anything like that, you bastards.*
hunks.sol: *Family Head? I have no intention of becoming anything like that, you bastards.*

hunks.baseline: Bitterness and relief both sat in his voice. The Head Elder’s brow twitched.
hunks.sol: Bitterness and relief mingled in his voice. The Head Elder’s brow twitched.

hunks.baseline: “The reason you betrayed us. The reason a day like today happened.”
hunks.sol: “The reason you betrayed us. The reason today happened.”

hunks.baseline: A succession fight.
hunks.sol: A succession struggle.

hunks.baseline: It felt like a huge puzzle piece had clicked into place. The smaller pieces that still hadn’t found their spots were fitting together one by one through their conversation.
hunks.sol: It felt as though one enormous puzzle piece had clicked into place. The smaller pieces still missing from the picture began falling into position one by one as their conversation continued.

hunks.baseline: The shift was so natural no one else there even noticed.
hunks.sol: The shift was so natural that no one else there would have noticed.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve heard nothing. Father never said a word about him.”
hunks.sol: “I have heard nothing. Father never said a word about him.”

hunks.baseline: “He was a petty man. For a lot of reasons, we brothers, who had once been close, drifted apart. And then that happened.”
hunks.sol: “He was petty. For many reasons, we brothers, once so close, gradually drifted apart. Then that happened.”

hunks.baseline: “Have you heard of the Ten Myriad Demonic Forces? They came in endless waves. The Murim Alliance was formed, but it was only an alliance of the Nine Sects and One Gang, and they were too busy defending their own bases.”
hunks.sol: “Have you heard the phrase ‘the Hundred Thousand Demons’? They came in endless waves. The Murim Alliance was formed, but it was little more than an alliance of the Nine Sects and One Gang, and they were too busy defending their own territories.”

hunks.baseline: That was also when the Head Elder had begun making a real name for himself.
hunks.sol: That was also when the Head Elder had begun to make a name for himself.

hunks.baseline: “The last battle was right here, at Eight Spring Gorge.”
hunks.sol: “The last battle was fought right here, at Eight Spring Gorge.”

hunks.baseline: His gaze seemed to grope toward some distant point in the past.
hunks.sol: His gaze seemed to search some distant point in the past.

hunks.baseline: “It was a long war. Many people died, and everyone was exhausted. But there was hope, too. Hope that they could finally return to their families. The three hundred volunteers sworn to die all shared that same hope.”
hunks.sol: “It was a long war. Many died, and everyone was exhausted. But there was hope, too. Hope that we could finally return to our families. All three hundred members of the death-defying force shared that hope.”

hunks.baseline: Until just now.
hunks.sol: Until now.

hunks.baseline: “We fought as we fell back deep into the gorge, but we were hopelessly outnumbered. Even as I swung my sword like a madman, one question would not leave me.”
hunks.sol: “We fought while retreating deeper into the gorge, but we were hopelessly outnumbered. Even as I swung my sword like a madman, one question refused to leave me.”

hunks.baseline: “How could they have set an ambush in advance? My elder brother should have been blocking the road into Eight Spring Gorge.”
hunks.sol: “How could they have prepared an ambush in advance? My elder brother should have been blocking the road into Eight Spring Gorge.”

hunks.baseline: Silent shock spread through the crowd. What little color was left in Jin Wikyung’s already pale face vanished.
hunks.sol: Silent shock spread through the crowd. What little color remained in Jin Wikyung’s already pale face vanished.

hunks.baseline: “The battle lasted half a day. We fought waiting for reinforcements that never came, and it was useless. Of the three hundred volunteers, only eight survived. When we finally returned to the family, I have never been able to forget the look on my brother’s face when he saw me.”
hunks.sol: “The battle lasted half a day. We fought while waiting for reinforcements that never came. It was no use. Of the three hundred, only eight survived. When we finally returned to the family, I could never forget the look on my brother’s face when he saw me.”

hunks.baseline: “Enough time has passed for mountains and rivers to change several times over. Did you think I came this far on mere suspicion?”
hunks.sol: “Enough time has passed for mountains and rivers to change several times over. Did you think I had come this far on mere suspicion?”

hunks.baseline: “My brother turned the war into an opportunity. I became a hero on the battlefield, but he became Family Head. Everyone who had followed me either died in battle or vanished afterward.”
hunks.sol: “My brother turned the war into an opportunity. I became a hero on the battlefield, but he became Family Head. Everyone who followed me had either died in battle or disappeared afterward.”

hunks.baseline: “Then going straight into the Elder Council—was that why?”
hunks.sol: “Then was that why you immediately joined the Elder Council?”

hunks.baseline: “Because that was the only way he would feel at ease. The only way I and my people could stay alive.”
hunks.sol: “Because that was the only way he would feel at ease. The only way my people and I could stay alive.”

hunks.baseline: I thought back to what he had said. The eight survivors who had followed the Head Elder and lived to the end.
hunks.sol: I thought back to what he had said. Eight people had survived to the end alongside the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: Guessing who they were was not hard.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t hard to guess who they were.

hunks.baseline: The survivors had sworn revenge. Revenge on the Family Head and the family that had betrayed them.
hunks.sol: The survivors had sworn revenge—revenge against the Family Head and the family that had betrayed them.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder slowly swept his gaze over the crowd.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder slowly swept his gaze across the crowd.

hunks.baseline: “It had been a very long wait.”
hunks.sol: “It has been a very long wait.”

hunks.baseline: Silence swallowed them. Disbelief, shock, shame. The feelings differed, but no one could easily speak.
hunks.sol: Silence swallowed everyone. Disbelief, shock, shame—their feelings differed, but no one could bring themselves to speak.

hunks.baseline: Well. No one except me.
hunks.sol: Well, except me.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t hold back the little snorts of laughter leaking out of me.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t hold back the little snorts of laughter escaping me.

hunks.baseline: I flicked my thumb at the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: I raised a thumb toward the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: “Revenge, my ass. You’re trying to become this, aren’t you?”
hunks.sol: “Revenge, my ass. You’re trying to become number one, aren’t you?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m right, aren’t I? Clear away everything in the way—the Jin Family of Taiyuan, the Mount Heng Sword Sect—and swallow Shanxi whole.”
hunks.sol: “I’m right, aren’t I? Clear out everything in your way—the Jin Family of Taiyuan, the Mount Heng Sword Sect—and swallow Shanxi whole.”

hunks.baseline: “You insolent—!”
hunks.sol: “You bastard—!”

hunks.baseline: Had the old man swallowed a locomotive boiler? Oh, right. No trains here.
hunks.sol: Did the old man swallow a locomotive smokestack or something?
Oh, right. No trains here.

hunks.baseline: I picked at my ear and went on.
hunks.sol: I picked at my ear and continued.

hunks.baseline: This had happened a full forty years ago. Even counting the Head Elder’s age, he had waited half his life.
hunks.sol: This had happened a full forty years ago. Even considering the Head Elder’s age, he had waited half his life.

hunks.baseline: “How many of the people who stabbed you in the back are even still alive? There’s late, and then there’s this late. And please, I’m begging you—don’t start with that bullshit about a gentleman waiting ten years to take revenge.”
hunks.sol: “How many of the people who stabbed you in the back are even still alive? There’s late, and then there’s *this* late. And please, I’m begging you—don’t start with that bullshit about a gentleman waiting ten years to take revenge.”

hunks.baseline: If holding out ten years made you a gentleman, did holding out forty make the Head Elder Jesus?
hunks.sol: If waiting ten years made you a gentleman, did waiting forty make the Head Elder Jesus?

hunks.baseline: It was nothing more than a crazy old man’s self-justification.
hunks.sol: This was nothing more than a crazy old man trying to justify himself.

hunks.baseline: “You run your mouth just because you’ve got one.”
hunks.sol: “You speak recklessly just because you have a mouth.”

hunks.baseline: “I did. What are you going to do about it?”
hunks.sol: “I do. What are you going to do about it?”

hunks.baseline: “Do I have to? After it’s gone this far?”
hunks.sol: “Do I need to? After it’s gone this far?”

hunks.baseline: The question was so obvious I snorted a laugh and pointed at the battlefield.
hunks.sol: The question was so ridiculous that I snorted and pointed across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: A mountain of corpses, a sea of blood. Utter pandemonium. The scene in front of us was exactly that.
hunks.sol: A mountain of corpses. A sea of blood. Utter pandemonium.
The scene before us was exactly that.

hunks.baseline: The chill in the Head Elder’s eyes wavered. But only for an instant.
hunks.sol: The chill in the Head Elder’s eyes wavered.
But only for an instant.

hunks.baseline: He muttered it like a jab at himself, then raised his sword.
hunks.sol: He muttered the words bitterly, then raised his sword.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s lips moved, and that was all.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s lips moved, but that was all.

hunks.baseline: A fight that ended only when one side died. They had come too far to turn back.
hunks.sol: This fight would end only when one side was dead. They had come too far to turn back.

hunks.baseline: A bearing and dignity that made his age meaningless. His white beard called an immortal to mind.
hunks.sol: His imposing bearing and dignity had made his age seem meaningless. His white beard had called an immortal to mind.

hunks.baseline: Of course, there were no immortals who mercilessly cut people in half.
hunks.sol: Of course, no immortal would mercilessly cut a man in half.

hunks.baseline: Drenched in blood, he swung his sword without pause. Looks mixed with awe and fear poured toward him.
hunks.sol: Drenched in blood, he swung his sword without pause. Everyone watched him with a mixture of awe and fear.

hunks.baseline: He just clearly wasn’t as strong as before.
hunks.sol: He just wasn’t as strong as before.

hunks.baseline: Peak master or not, the martial artists here were the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s elite. Men who had fought across the battlefield under Jin Wikyung, skilled enough to have survived the earlier clash with the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: Peak master or not, the martial artists here were the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s elite. They had crossed the battlefield under Jin Wikyung and were skilled enough to survive their earlier clash with the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder knocked aside blades driving in from every direction, his face darkening. In the old days, he would have cut down everything in his path with Sword Energy.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder knocked aside blades driving in from every direction, his expression dark. At his full strength, he would have cut through everything in his path with Sword Energy.

hunks.baseline: Proof that the internal energy that had once seemed like a spring that never ran dry had finally hit bottom.
hunks.sol: It was proof that the internal energy that had once seemed like an inexhaustible spring was finally running dry.

hunks.baseline: Sword wounds began to multiply across the Head Elder’s body. Unlike before, most of the blood was his.
hunks.sol: Sword wounds began multiplying across the Head Elder’s body. Unlike before, most of the blood was now his.

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t about to miss that opening. The spear I drove with everything I had tore a handful of flesh from his side.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t about to miss that opening. The spear I drove forward with all my strength tore a handful of flesh from his side.

hunks.baseline: Even through the pain, the Head Elder cut down a martial artist and charged me. He meant it this time; a faint Sword Energy gathered along the swinging blade.
hunks.sol: Even through the pain, the Head Elder cut down another martial artist and charged at me. He had clearly made up his mind. Faint Sword Energy gathered along his swinging blade.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder turned with a twisted face.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder turned, his face twisting.

hunks.baseline: “My family members are dying. Is a sneak attack really that important?”
hunks.sol: “My people are dying. Does a sneak attack really matter?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung looked at the Head Elder with a complicated expression.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung regarded the Head Elder with a conflicted expression.

hunks.baseline: The flow of the battlefield had been ours for a long time. But the black-clad men kept resisting stubbornly, and the screams and corpses still showed no sign of thinning out.
hunks.sol: The flow of the battle had shifted to our side long ago. But the black-clad men continued to resist, and there were still no fewer screams or corpses.

hunks.baseline: The staggering Head Elder straightened his back. A sharp gleam was already flashing in his eyes, and a blade-like aura began to rise.
hunks.sol: The staggering Head Elder straightened his back. A keen light flashed in his eyes, and a blade-like aura began to rise from him.

hunks.baseline: A last desperate struggle?
hunks.sol: A final desperate struggle?
No. It was more than that.

hunks.baseline: No. More than that. Someone suddenly came to mind.
hunks.sol: Someone suddenly came to mind.

hunks.baseline: The last sight of him as he was dying overlapped with the Head Elder now.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s current appearance overlapped with the last sight of Jopil as he lay dying.

hunks.baseline: *Innate qi. He’s drawing up his innate qi.*
hunks.sol: *Innate qi. He’s drawing out his innate qi.*

hunks.baseline: If internal energy was acquired power, piled up by circulating qi and taking elixirs, innate qi was the opposite. It was the root of the human body—life force itself, for all intents.
hunks.sol: If internal energy was an acquired force accumulated by circulating one’s qi and consuming elixirs, innate qi was the opposite. It was the root of the human body—life force itself, for all intents and purposes.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder was staking his life to use it.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder was staking his life to draw upon it.

hunks.baseline: He spat blood and raised his sword. His life was going out fast, but his sword shone more brilliantly than it ever had.
hunks.sol: He spat out blood and raised his sword. His life was fading rapidly, but his blade shone more brilliantly than ever.

hunks.baseline: The moment I saw that overwhelming sight, a single word slipped out of me.
hunks.sol: The instant I saw that overwhelming sight, a single phrase escaped my lips.

hunks.baseline: My heart pounded just from looking at it. I could feel a terrifying power that far outstripped Sword Energy.
hunks.sol: My heart pounded merely from looking at it. I could feel a terrifying power that far surpassed Sword Energy.

hunks.baseline: His red eyes, the capillaries bursting one after another, locked on me.
hunks.sol: His blood-red eyes, their tiny vessels bursting one after another, locked onto me.

hunks.baseline: But the Head Elder was already gone from that spot.
hunks.sol: But the Head Elder was already gone.

hunks.baseline: In a single step he compressed fifty feet and brought his sword down on me.
hunks.sol: With a single step, he crossed fifty feet and brought his sword down on me.
I was dead.

hunks.baseline: I was dead. I was going to die.
hunks.sol: I was going to die.

hunks.baseline: I wrung every muscle in my body. The last scant handful of internal energy raced for the spearhead.
hunks.sol: I squeezed every last ounce of strength from my muscles. The last scant handful of internal energy raced toward the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: It was a final struggle, and a show of respect for the life I had lived so fiercely until now.
hunks.sol: It was my final desperate struggle—the least respect I could show the life I had fought so fiercely to live.

hunks.baseline: The last strike, carrying every bit of strength I had left, shot forward.
hunks.sol: My final strike, carrying every last bit of strength I had, shot forward.
